name: Wakeshift
description: Wakes OpenClaw sessions when an app they watch through Wakeshift sends something. Messages arrive as outside information, never as the user.

issuer.description: The Wakeshift whose beacons the plugin trusts, e.g. https://app.wakeshift.ai (the installer sets it).

heartbeatTarget.description: Where a woken turn's reply goes, as heartbeat.target (default: last).
